user.title: Luz Indexada
user.description: Real 15-minute final electricity price for Portuguese indexed tariffs. How do you reach the API?

rapidapi.title: RapidAPI
rapidapi.description: Subscribe to Luz Indexada on RapidAPI and paste your X-RapidAPI-Key. This integration uses about 3-5 requests a day with the supplier comparison (90-160 a month; 2-4 without it), so it needs the Pro plan; Basic (15 requests/month) is only for a quick try.

data_description.rapidapi_host: Only change this if the listing host changes.

tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: Prices exclude VAT unless you include it. With VAT, 23% is applied to every component (on a real bill the first 200 kWh per 30 days at ≤ 6.9 kVA pay 6%). Tariffs marked (estimate) use indicative values.

data_description.window_hours: Length of the cheapest contiguous block, in steps of 0.25 h.
data_description.compare: Adds today's average price of every other tariff (from the same requests) and an estimated monthly cost per supplier (about 1 extra request a day).
data_description.monthly_kwh: Used only for the monthly cost comparison (standard ERSE consumption profile).
data_description.kva: Used only for the monthly cost comparison (power term).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a valid key.

error.rate_limited: Too many requests (or the monthly quota is used up). Try again later.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with https:// or http://.
error.cycle_not_offered: This tariff does not offer that cycle.

abort.already_configured: This tariff and cycle are already configured.
